shots.content: Inside a dining room, a rectangular table stands between a sideboard and patio doors, with a window along one side. A woman in a burgundy blouse sits at the sideboard-side window seat and asks a question, a man in an olive sweater sits at the patio-side window seat, and a woman in a navy blazer sits at the sideboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the patio-door end, looking lengthwise along the dining table toward the sideboard, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in an olive sweater leaves the patio-side window seat and exits the venue, and the woman in a burgundy blouse asks a question.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a burgundy blouse speaks.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the dining table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and the sideboard-end seat in frame.
